reason: No import-linter or lint rule enforces it (.flake8, pyproject ruff have none). Both outliers are Job classes whose run(sink: EventSink) takes the sink abstraction from events/event_sink.py, a recurring job-to-sink pattern (job_runner.py injects HttpEventSink), so new jobs of that kind would be flagged falsely; hesitated with ACCEPT as a layering rule.
